title: Algebraic extension and restriction of valuation coarsenings
statement: Let $K\subseteq L$ be a finite algebraic extension of fields [def-pc-field-extension], and let $W\subseteq L$ be a valuation ring with fraction field $L$ [def-trf-valuation-ring]. Put $V=W\cap K$, a valuation ring of $K$. In additive notation let $w:L^\times\to\Gamma_W=L^\times/W^\times$ be its surjective valuation and identify $\Gamma_V=w(K^\times)$ with an ordered subgroup of $\Gamma_W$. Then $\Gamma_W/\Gamma_V$ is torsion: for every $\delta\in\Gamma_W$ there is an integer $n>0$ with $n\delta\in\Gamma_V$. Restriction $W'\mapsto W'\cap K$ is an inclusion-preserving bijection from the valuation rings $W\subseteq W'\subseteq L$ onto the valuation rings $V\subseteq V'\subseteq K$. Moreover $W'=L$ if and only if its restriction is $K$; in particular every proper valuation overring of $V$ lifts to a proper valuation overring of $W$. Here a valuation overring is a valuation ring in the same fraction field containing the indicated ring. No henselian or separability hypothesis is imposed.
